fulfillment_orders_paid_mode_required.name: fulfillment_orders_paid_mode_required
fulfillment_orders_paid_mode_required.value: "fulfillment_orders"."status" not in ('PAID_PENDING_FULFILLMENT', 'FULFILLING', 'SHIPPED', 'FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTION') or "fulfillment_orders"."payment_mode" is not null

order_shipments_logistics_fee_currency_p.name: order_shipments_logistics_fee_currency_pair
order_shipments_logistics_fee_currency_p.value: "order_shipments"."logistics_fee_minor" is null or "order_shipments"."logistics_currency" is not null

wallet_transactions_order_link_matches_t.name: wallet_transactions_order_link_matches_type
wallet_transactions_order_link_matches_t.value: ("wallet_transactions"."transaction_type" in ('ORDER_DEBIT', 'ORDER_REFUND') and "wallet_transactions"."order_id" is not null) or ("wallet_transactions"."transaction_type" in ('ADMIN_CREDIT', 'ADMIN_DEBIT') and "wallet_transactions"."order_id" is null)
